name: starmemory
description: Hybrid recall plugin for Claude Code and Codex: Tantivy BM25 + usearch HNSW over LMDB, fused by reciprocal rank. One Rust addon, no C++ toolchain.

scripts.build:native: cd native && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release && cp "target/release/libstarmemory_native.$(uname | grep -q Darwin && echo dylib || echo so)" starmemory_native.node
